LESSON: WRITING 10.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: THANK YOU NOTES AND CONGRATULATORY NOTES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.5: Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you notes and Congratulatory notes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you notes and Congratulatory notes, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How are strong emotions expressed in writing? 2. Why should one write how they feel about something?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you notes and Congratulatory notes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy is developed as the learner successsfully creates congratulatory and thank you notes individually or in small

groups

• Learning to Learn is enhanced as learners take charge of their own learning and search for sample congratulatory and thank

you notes from newspapers, magazines and textbooks and read through them in pairs.

Values:
Love is fostered as the learner as the learner shows a caring attitude while collaborating with peers to create congratulatory and

thank you notes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Life Skills Education - effective communication is developed as the learner creates congratulatory notes and thank you notes

and look for artistc ways to make them presentable.

• Financial literacy is inculcated as learners share ideas on how art can be a source of income.

Link to other subjects:

Congratulatory notes and thank you notes are forms of functional writing which is also an aspect learnt in Kiswahili.
